intro: Covert Ops - Beta is an Alliance mission organized by the gnome engineer Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains. Building upon previous sabotage against the encroaching Venture Company, this operation sends an agent deep into Windshear Mine to trigger explosive diversions and extract vital operational letters. The retrieved intelligence serves both gnome curiosity and the territorial defense of the regional night elf Sentinels.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Plan Beta's just like Plan Alpha, friend.
We cause a distraction and then steal their precious letters.
The key is to get their letters... Remember that.
The pages I gave you already will tell you where to plant the explosives. Just get back here alive and with those letters....

clips.title: Completion
paras: Incredible, friend! Kaela and the Sentinels will be so happy. With your skill and my creations, we're unstoppable.
